up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2938 (Protein kinase C gamma type) that have exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, taxonomy ID (tax_id), canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_cte AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2938') SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM target_cte t JOIN assays ass ON ass.tid = t.tid JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON t.td = td.tid WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
